hero.description: The scientific, cultural and social institute of Alfa BK University — dedicated to advancing knowledge, fostering dialogue, and honouring the legacy of Petar Karić.

about.title: WHERE KNOWLEDGE MEETS LEGACY
paragraphs: The Institute Petar Karić was established in memory of Petar Karić, a founding member of the Karić family whose vision gave life to this university. It carries forward his values: dedication to learning, commitment to the public good, and belief in education as a transformative force.

The Institute serves as the scientific and cultural arm of Alfa BK University — organising academic conferences, public lectures, student award programmes, and cultural events that enrich intellectual life on campus and in the wider community.

mission.title: Institute Mission
mission.desc: To advance scientific inquiry, preserve cultural heritage, and nurture the next generation of scholars, innovators, and civic leaders — in Serbia and beyond.

researchProjects.title: Legal & Ethical Frameworks in Business
